extracted.intended_audience: general readers, researchers, students, and analysts seeking country-level trade partner and administrative-division reference data
extracted.subtask_description: A worldwide reference list giving (1) major trade partners and their percentage shares for each country (circa 2000s) and (2) first-order administrative divisions (provinces/regions/states/counties) for countries. Intended as factual reference material for comparative, historical, or descriptive uses.
